# ICCQ — International Conference on Code Quality

> ICCQ is a peer-reviewed academic computer science conference on code quality: static and dynamic analysis, program verification, programming language design, software bug detection, and software maintenance. It is a one-day event, held annually in Russia since 2021, in English. Chair: Yegor Bugayenko (yegor256@gmail.com). Homepage: https://www.iccq.ru

## About

ICCQ happens once a year and is hosted by a Russian university,
  deliberately a different one each edition:
  Moscow, Innopolis, St. Petersburg, Ekaterinburg, and Novosibirsk so far.
The working language is English and the program is international —
  the Program Committee is drawn from universities across the world,
  and recent editions are hybrid, so speakers may present remotely over Zoom.

Nothing costs money: no submission fee, no publication fee, no registration fee.
Talks are streamed live on the YouTube channel and can be watched without registering.

Every paper receives at least three double-blind reviews from Program Committee members.
A paper with any "reject" review is not accepted,
  no limit is set on the number of accepted papers,
  and the Chair of the PC may veto up to 20% of the accepted ones.
Submissions follow the acmart sigplan template, run 6 to 20 pages,
  and any datasets or source code behind them must be deposited to Zenodo.
The full set of organizational rules lives on the Principles page.

## Editions

- [ICCQ-2026 — 6th edition, 12 December 2026, Novosibirsk, Russia (hybrid), with A.P. Ershov Institute of Informatics Systems](https://www.iccq.ru/2026.html)
- [ICCQ-2025 — 5th edition, 13 December 2025, Ekaterinburg, Russia](https://www.iccq.ru/2025.html)
- [ICCQ-2024 — 4th edition, 22 June 2024, Innopolis University, Russia](https://www.iccq.ru/2024.html)
- [ICCQ-2023 — 3rd edition, 22 April 2023, St. Petersburg University, Russia](https://www.iccq.ru/2023.html)
- [ICCQ-2022 — 2nd edition, 23 April 2022, Innopolis, Kazan, Russia](https://www.iccq.ru/2022.html)
- [ICCQ-2021 — 1st edition, 27 March 2021, online](https://www.iccq.ru/2021.html)

## Topics

- Static and dynamic program analysis
- Program verification and formal methods
- Programming language design
- Software bug detection
- Software maintenance and evolution

## Publication

Proceedings are submitted to IEEE Xplore and indexed by DBLP, Scopus, and Web of Science.
Papers from every past edition, 2021 through 2025, are available in IEEE Xplore.
